title: Tensor and adjunction compatibility of canonical ringed-topos path comparisons
statement:
Let $W,X_1,X_2,Y$ be topoi presented by sites small in the universe of [def-weil-size-convention], with sheaves of commutative rings and morphisms of ringed topoi $f_i:W\to X_i$, $g_i:X_i\to Y$ for $i=1,2$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Fix an isomorphism $g_1f_1\cong g_2f_2$ of ringed-topos morphisms, compatible with the structural ring maps. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the canonical derived pullback/direct-image adjunctions, and the tensor comparisons $t_h:Lh^*(K\otimes^L H)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*K\otimes^L Lh^*H$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Put $P_i=Lf_i^*Lg_i^*$ and $V_i=Rg_{i*}Rf_{i*}$, with the composite adjunction $P_i\dashv V_i$ and its counit $e_i$ [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. Let $\theta:P_2\xrightarrow{\sim}P_1$ be the canonical comparison obtained from derived pullback composition and the specified ringed commutation isomorphism. Let $c:V_1\xrightarrow{\sim}V_2$ be the canonical comparison obtained from the direct-image composition isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] and the same commutation isomorphism. Define
$$d_{i,K,H}=t_{f_i,Lg_i^*K,Lg_i^*H}\circ Lf_i^*(t_{g_i,K,H}):P_i(K\otimes^L H)\longrightarrow P_iK\otimes^L P_iH.$$
Then for all $K,H\in D(Y)$,
$$d_{1,K,H}\circ\theta_{K\otimes^L H}=(\theta_K\otimes^L\theta_H)\circ d_{2,K,H}.$$
Moreover $c$ is the conjugate of $\theta$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. Explicitly, for all $Z\in D(W)$,
$$e_{2,Z}\circ P_2(c_Z)=e_{1,Z}\circ\theta_{V_1Z}:P_2V_1Z\longrightarrow Z.$$
No exactness of the underived module pullbacks is assumed.
